text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Without mankind, 
the Goshiki Shuntaisai cannot be held.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, <chrname>-sama. 
Through the Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
please protect the future of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: One more time!!

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
...Are you here to observe Blast-san's 
independent practice as well, Tsunade-san?
choice_data_list:
Yes. I was hoping to speak with you too, 
President.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reviewed the email I had received 
earlier 
from the President of the Soaring Gallop 
Preservation Society. 
Written within was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A formal request: "There is a role in 
Soaring Gallop 
that I would like to entrust to you."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's joining in on Soaring Gallop 
starting today?!

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Historically, all Umamusume who took on 
Soaring Gallop had the order 
in which they cleared the obstacles—in 
other words, the routine— 
composed for them by a human.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
However, I am an Umamusume myself. 
...Which is why 
I have requested that Tsunade-san assume 
that duty.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
During the previous Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
the prior Tsunade fulfilled that very same 
responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~! Boo is super happy about 
it... but Trainer, 
it's your first time doing this, right? 
Won't it be too tough?
choice_data_list:
Leave it to me! I've read through all the 
reference materials!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then let's all head to the Program Venue! 
Ready, set—...
choice_data_list: Go—!

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I have imparted all the 
fundamentals 
that an Umamusume like myself can teach to 
Blast-san.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Blast-san's nature is so 
remarkably... Did Azuma-sama 
know all along when choosing her as a 
Divine Steed?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Whether Soaring Gallop succeeds or fails 
rests entirely 
upon how well human and Umamusume can join 
hands. 
That is the heart of it.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Just as it was twelve years ago. 
For Soaring Gallop is a sacred rite shared 
between Umamusume and mankind.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we start with? 
Boo will follow whatever training you set 
up, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
First, I'd like to gather more data on 
your capabilities.

First, I want to gather more information 
about you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An instructor of Soaring Gallop apparently 
needs to devise the routine, 
deciding which obstacles the Umamusume 
should tackle and when.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll need data. 
Specific information tailored directly to 
Soaring Gallop, distinct from regular 
running.
choice_data_list:
Mind if I measure how far you can long 
jump?
Could I measure your long jump distance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The human world record for the long jump 
is just under nine meters. 
I drew a line on the ground as a rough 
marker—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Is this all I gotta do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with effortless grace, 
Blast Onepiece cleared human limits by a 
mile.
choice_data_list: Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whew! What's next? 
Which obstacle do you want me to clear?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I always knew Umamusume possessed athletic 
abilities far superior to humans. 
Yet seeing it demonstrated so vividly 
outside a racetrack...
choice_data_list: You Umamusume really are unbelievable!!
You Umamusume are truly extraordinary!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My cheeks flushed at the sight of prowess 
completely beyond human scales. 
To bring out this potential, what kind of 
training plan should I construct?
choice_data_list:
You blow past my expectations without 
breaking a sweat...!

You shatter my expectations like it's 
nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
O-Ooh...? 
Trainer...?!
choice_data_list:
Ah, sorry, out of nowhere! I just got so 
excited...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's fine! Don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
............U-Um, hey! Trainer! 
I'm gonna jump over that obstacle over 
there next.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—Watch me this time too, okay?! 
Boo can definitely pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, Blast Onepiece cleared a wall 
standing well over two meters high 
with ease...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
How was that?! 
Did Boo blow past your expectations 
again?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you were absolutely incredible...!!
Yes, you were truly amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Youth Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, another new record! 
You're amazing, Boo-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...It's just the same. 
You humans always give Boo and the rest of 
us—...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, there's more! Way more! 
We Umamusume can do all kinds of things!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So get excited! Let your heart pound, 
too!! 
Whatever you're feeling— 
I want you to throw it all right back at 
Boo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, one after another, 
Blast Onepiece showcased everything she 
excelled at.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: And next... I can do—something like—this—!
choice_data_list: Whoa, that was a gorgeous turn...!
Wow, what a beautiful turn...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, right? I actually learned 
equestrian gymnastics 
back at my youth club, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Bajutsu," or course gymnastics, 
originated in the West 
and is a sport that makes full use of an 
Umamusume's physical abilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is divided into multiple disciplines, 
including dressage and show jumping.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that after retiring from 
racing, 
some Umamusume aim to turn professional in 
various Bajutsu events.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I did dressage! 
I'd spin round and round 
with all those fancy ojou-sama girls!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Trainer! 
Bajutsu and Soaring Gallop have a lot in 
common! 
I'm sure reading a book about Bajutsu 
would help you out!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Blast-san. 
If you need a book on Bajutsu... well, I 
was just about to return this one... 
...S-So, please take it, if you'd like...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Cheval~! Thanks a bunch! 
Trainer, let's take a look at it together!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Boo is great at eating food, too! 
I never leave leftovers—I gobble it all 
up!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
When I go for seconds, 
I won't leave a single scrap of lettuce 
behind either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――And so, I listened to Blast Onepiece, 
observed her, and learned so much from 
her.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Next up, I'm gonna――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blast Onepiece pointed toward the 
obstacles set up across the program 
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
――clear those huuuuge obstacles one after 
another!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
When I do, your eyes are gonna sparkle, 
right? 
Like, 'Blast, you're incredible!'
choice_data_list: Yeah! That's exactly how it'll go!
Yep! That's exactly how it'll go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I answer without a shred of doubt. 
Because I know where her strengths lie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All the conversations and time we shared 
together revealed to me what she does 
best.
choice_data_list: Now, show me what you've got!
Now, show me what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Nnnh... you bet!!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...Chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Through Soaring Gallop, a person comes 
to understand 
the forte of the horsegirl performer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And the horsegirl, seeing herself through 
their eyes, 
shall execute a splendid leap.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Because they are of different kinds, 
what reflects in their eyes will differ. 
Yet that very difference aids the 
horsegirl, guiding her to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
――Soaring Gallop is, indeed, 
a sacred rite between horsegirl and human.

title: That Too Is Part of the Ritual
